<action type="say">
“Tomorrow at 27:89” won’t work as a confirmation code, and 27:89 isn’t a valid time, so that’s almost certainly not what the restaurant or booking system gave you.

To cancel the reservation in this system, I need the actual confirmation code. It usually looks like:
- A short mix of letters and numbers, e.g. “A3F9KZ” or “R-482913”, or
- Sometimes just numbers, e.g. “584203”.

You can usually find it:
- In the confirmation email you received when you booked
- In a text message from the restaurant or booking app
- In the “Reservations” section of the app/website you used to book

Please check that confirmation and either:
- Copy–paste the exact confirmation code here, or
- Type it exactly as shown (including any letters, numbers, and dashes).

Once you send me that real confirmation code, I’ll proceed to cancel the reservation for you.</action>
